inputs.text: [excited] ang… KY… loh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "ankylo" means fused, all stiff.
[happily] Yep — its back was fused together like tough armor. [calm] It lived in North America, sixty-six million years ago.
[gasps] Sixty-six million? That's T. rex's time, right?
[confident] Exactly, [pauses] and Triceratops too. [amazed] All three lived in the same land, at the same time.
